name: luh-bvp-dyn-viscoelastic-stochastic-tsm
notes:
In this repository the boundary value problems considered in the paper "Simulation of the dynamic behavior of viscoelasticstructures with random material parameters using time-separated stochastic mechanics" [1] are presented. 
For both boundary value problems, the push rod and the spring, the displacement of the mesh over time is presented in a short video. The visualized displacement of the push rod is increased by a factor of 10. The displacement of the spring is not visually increase. The dynamic response of the structures is in addition visible and motivates the paper [1].

[1] Hendrik Geisler, Jan Nagel, Philipp Junker. Simulation of the dynamic behavior of viscoelastic structures with random material parameters using time-separated stochastic mechanics. 2022 to appear.
